subject: Settlement cadence and split-invoice handoff for multi-entity customers
messages:
From: Elena Petrova <elena@thenovahealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Singh <maya@novamed.ai>
Date: Sat, 09 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Clarify split-invoice approach + sample PO (NovaHealth)

Hi Sean / Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at NovaHealth is aligned on running the pilot with split legal entities, but our procurement needs a clear settlement cadence and sample invoice that shows how line items will be split across entities and cost centers. Specifically: 

- We need separate invoices for US and EU legal entities (US entity for subscription & support, EU entity for local services).
- Each invoice should include a mapping to our cost centers (Clinical Platform, Integrations, Data Ops).
- VAT treatment needs to be explicit on EU invoice (reverse charge vs. billed).
- Prefer monthly settlement, but procurement is open to net-30 for the first two months if we can show clear reconciliations.

Can you send a sample split invoice and a suggested settlement schedule? I attached the PO we plan to use. Also include the fields your AR team needs so we can route payments without delays.

Appreciate a short timeline so procurement can approve the pilot agreement this week.

Thanks,
Elena
Finance Director, NovaHealth
elena@thenovahealth.com

Attachments: NovaHealth_PO_5421.pdf (PDF, 86KB)

From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
To: Elena Petrova <elena@thenovahealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 10 Aug 2025 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clarify split-invoice approach + sample PO (NovaHealth)

Elena — thanks for the clarity and the PO. Short answer: yes, we can do a split-invoice flow that maps line items to your cost centers and issues separate legal invoices per entity. Proposed next steps below so we can get procurement comfortable quickly:

1) Draft sample invoices: we'll produce two PDFs (US / EU) showing the same consumption lines with entity-specific billing headers and cost-center tags.
2) Settlement cadence: recommend monthly invoicing with a 30-day payment term for the pilot; we can tighten to net-15 after Q1 if desired.
3) VAT approach: Kimberly will propose the EU reverse-charge wording or VAT-charged alternative depending on your tax counsel.
4) Remittance & reconciliation: provide AR routing fields we need (AP contact, PO number placement, remit-to email).

I've attached a split-invoice template for your review and a short mutual action checklist so Procurement can sign off quickly. Can we schedule a 30-min sync tomorrow (Mon) to run through the sample invoice and finalize the remit instructions?

Thanks — I'll get the sample PDFs ready once we align on remit details.

—Sean
Sean Gallagher
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
sean@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: RH-Split-Invoice-Template.xlsx (XLSX, 34KB); MUT-Checklist-5421.docx (DOCX, 12KB)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Elena Petrova <elena@thenovahealth.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Aug 2025 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clarify split-invoice approach + sample PO (NovaHealth)

Elena / team — adding more details on the tax and remit side so your procurement has everything for approval. Quick notes below and a suggested mapping layout you can paste into your AP system.

VAT / Tax handling (EU invoice):
- If NovaHealth provides a valid VAT number and the transaction qualifies for B2B cross-border services, we will apply reverse-charge wording on the EU invoice (no VAT charged).
- If the services are consumed locally and VAT should be charged, we'll include VAT and show the tax breakdown line-by-line.

Remit & legal entities:
- US invoices: Redwood Inference, Inc.
  - Remit-to: accounts-payable@redwood.com
  - Tax ID: 12-3456789
  - Bank: FirstWest Bank, ACH: 011000015, Account: 987654321
- EU invoices: Redwood Inference Europe B.V.
  - Remit-to: eu-ap@redwood.com
  - VAT ID: NL8191.23.456.B01
  - IBAN: NL91ABNA0417164300

Suggested invoice line mapping (example you can import into NovaHealth AP):
- Line item: "Prod: Token Consumption" -> Cost center: Clinical Platform -> Entity: US
- Line item: "Integration Connectors" -> Cost center: Integrations -> Entity: EU
- Line item: "Support - Premium" -> Cost center: Data Ops -> Entity: US

Settlement cadence recommendation: Monthly invoices, payment term: Net-30 for pilot, include a consolidated reconciliation CSV at month-end that lists original invoice line, cost center tag, entity, and allocation percentage. That CSV will be attached to both entity invoices for easy matching.

Let us know: AP contact name, AP email, and whether your system needs PO in the invoice header or the line-level PO reference. Once you confirm, Sean and I will create the two PDF samples and route for signature.

—Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Senior Manager, Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
kimberly@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0167

Sean / Kimberly / Grace — this is great, thank you.

Confirmed: NovaHealth can accept monthly invoicing on net-30 for the pilot. AP contact info below so you can populate the template: 
- AP contact: Miguel Alvarez
- AP inbox: finance@thenovahealth.com
- PO placement: header and line-level (both preferred)

I've attached a signed MOU (non-financial) to move the pilot forward — procurement asks we receive the sample invoices and the reconciliation CSV before Sept 1 so they can set up auto-pay. If you can provide the two sample PDFs and the reconciliation CSV by EOD Aug 15 we will route to treasury for enrollment.

Also copied Maya from Integration who will confirm which integration lines should be mapped to EU vs US cost centers; she may send a short mapping file tomorrow.

Thanks again — looking forward to getting the pilot started.

Best,
Elena
Finance Director, NovaHealth

Attachments: signed-MUT-2025.pdf (PDF, 48KB)
